svg.title: Real LongMemEval conversations and sampled memories
svg.desc: 1500 source-turn samples, 100 Ext-Dense memory samples, and 24 conversation paths from the existing shared UMAP fit. Each path stays within one session. This is a projection preview, not a memory-quality score.
